input: Convert /data/users.csv to a JSON array where each row becomes an object with the column headers as keys. Print the resulting JSON to stdout.

tool_calls: jq -R -s 'split("\n") | map(select(length>0) | split(",")) | .[0] as $h | .[1:] | map([$h, .] | transpose | map({(.[0]): .[1]}) | add)' /data/users.csv
